title: Baseline: write the rule changes the improvement map decided
story: The mandatory rules file now says agents merge their own pull requests on green except PRD, ADR, prototype, CLAUDE.md, outside-change and owner-merges ones; later PRD tiers are blocked by the earlier tier's final stories; a PRD that names screens waits for its merged prototype; maps after the first may end in ADRs only; the harvest asks one question per group; new tests are budgeted; and local test runs size their test copies.
no_qa_reason: A rules document only; nothing a user can run.
